base_model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B (Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration; vision tower loaded, frozen, unused)
method: low-rank adapters on every nn.Linear of the text backbone (186 modules), r=32, alpha=64, base weights frozen in bf16; adapters merged into the weights before saving

data.source: passages of up to 500 characters cut from Chinese articles and comment collections, at most 3 per file, train and test files disjoint
data.labels: one LLM, JSON-schema-constrained output, 20 passages per request; 5-10 verbatim phrases per passage ordered by importance

input: chat template, thinking off; user: 摘出下面这段材料的关键短语，按重要性从高到低排列，只输出 JSON。\n材料：{text}
target: compact JSON {"keyphrases":[...]} followed by <|im_end|>; phrases not found verbatim in the passage are dropped
loss: cross-entropy on target tokens only; lm_head applied only at target positions
optimizer: AdamW, lr 1e-4, weight decay 0, 5% warmup + cosine, grad clip 1.0
note: dev loss is lowest after epoch 1, but the 3-epoch model scores higher on the held-out passages (exact recall 0.521 vs 0.499), so the 3-epoch model is released
hardware: RTX 4090 48G, 439 seconds, peak 20.6 GB (the same recipe on Qwen3.5-4B: 1071 seconds)
